fields.label: Provider workspace
fields.description: Exact private provider workspace identity containing the selected conversations; it must equal the integration.slack private configuration setting.

fields.label: Selected channel identities
fields.description: Exact private public or private channel identities selected for one bounded review; direct messages are unavailable.

fields.label: Review window
fields.description: Provider-neutral policy window whose exact instants are pinned when preparation begins.

fields.label: Explicit thread references
fields.description: Optional exact private conversation and root-message references in conversation:<id>/thread:<id> form; every conversation must also be selected, and each explicit root is read as one complete policy-bounded thread even when it falls outside the separate conversation window.
